name: Announce critical incidents
steps: Page the owning team's escalation path

name: Publish a status page update
conditions: Severity is one of CRITICAL, ERROR
steps: Draft a customer update from the latest incident update
Await approval from the incident lead

name: Auto-declare on queue backlog
conditions: Priority is one of Medium, High, Urgent
steps: Assign the owning team from the catalog

name: Nudge overdue follow-ups
conditions: Due date is in the past
steps: Send a reminder to the follow-up owner
